title: Only white color in Current blood glucose and Status lights
body: Build version 3.4.0.0 Android 15 (Linneage OS 22.2) I installed Linneage OS / Android 15 to a Sony Xperia XZ2 and with build 3.4.0.0 I only have white color in Current blood glucose and Status lights. See the screenshot.

comments.body: It must be related to LineageOS or accessibility settings
